	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWW.Link()
	For each WWP_MailTemplate
		where WWPMailTemplateName = &WWPMailTemplateName
		Form.Caption = WWPMailTemplateDescription.ToString()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	If (&Exists)
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif
	&RecordDescription = Form.Caption
	If &Session.Get(!'DiscussionThreadIdToOpen') <> ''
		ddc_Discussions.Open()
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If Not WWP_HasDiscussionMessages(!'WWP_MailTemplate', WWPMailTemplateName)
		ddc_Discussions.Icon = "far fa-comment"
	EndIf
	If (WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(!'WWP_MailTemplate', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord))
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = True
	Else
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = False
	Endif
